purpose: Outcome-blind audit of genuinely different causal information available before entry inside the M10W17 stable HIGH-ATR bullish opportunity regime, after HBR1/HER1/HRC1 failed to produce an advancing entry family.
target_regime: D1 EMA20>EMA30>EMA40 AND H4 EMA20>EMA30 AND H1 TORYS MACD line(6,13,4)>0 AND H1 Wilder ATR14 percentile100>=0.67
causal_alignment: For an M15 decision timestamp, use only lower-timeframe bars whose nominal close time is <= the decision. Never use the M1/M5 bar opening exactly at decision before it closes.
required_outputs: feature availability/missingness by year and all
p05/p25/p50/p75/p95/min/max for every causal numeric feature
audit proving no +240m return, PF, PnL, win/loss label or future path was read or computed

interpretation_rules.next: Only after this audit may M10W23 preregister at most three simple microstructure entry families using features that are causally available, sufficiently dense and non-degenerate. Their thresholds must come from fixed structural definitions or outcome-blind distribution cuts, never from profit ranking.
